Tandemlog native text engine — third-party notices

Scope: exact crates.io pins/checksums in native/text_engine/Cargo.lock and Rust
standard-library distribution 1.99.0 (b940084d7eb6a299eb4bfeb8e34901bc051e7ac4).
Reviewed target dependency graphs: Linux x86_64 GNU, Android arm64/armv7/x86_64,
Windows x86_64 MSVC, Apple arm64 macOS/iOS. Graphs are metadata checks, not proof
that each target has been built. Platform-specific packaging must ship this file.
The application own license and OS/platform runtime notices remain separate.

For alternative MIT OR Apache-2.0 permissions, distribution may use the MIT
alternative; both supplied texts are retained conservatively. unicode-ident also
requires Unicode-3.0 attribution, included below. parking's additional Rust
notice is included. No proprietary dependency license was identified in the
reviewed native graph. r-efi offers MIT OR Apache OR LGPL alternatives but is
not enabled on these native targets; no LGPL alternative is selected here.
Its package omits license-text files; enabling a UEFI graph needs fresh review.
The wasm/getrandom/bumpalo chain and Redox-only dependencies may appear in the
lock without being compiled for current targets; supplied notices are retained
when available. Proc macros and their proc-macro2/quote/syn/unicode-ident graph
execute on the build host, not as runtime libraries; generated code remains
covered conservatively by these notices. Standard-library attribution includes
its full supplied third-party library notices (a conservative superset across
platforms), preserving exceptional permissive license terms beyond MIT/Apache.

Build-hook audit: reviewed supplied build.rs and included local probe sources.
Enabled hooks perform target/compiler feature detection, rustc version or local
metadata compilation probes, and generated files under OUT_DIR. No enabled hook
fetches network content, installs software, or invokes a proprietary SDK/tool.
Excluded wasm-bindgen-shared additionally invokes local git rev-parse for
version metadata and hashes local schema files; no network fetch there either.
Cargo/rustc may invoke configured compiler wrappers; that is environment-owned,
not authorization for arbitrary wrapper behavior. Changes to pins/features/
targets/toolchain require revalidation; app builds must not download notices.

Exact license texts follow, transcribed from packaged files except Yrs0.28.0,
whose missing package LICENSE was retrieved from its official upstream commit
23b7f5693bbf9e7d26340c521ee8647f79bdfba2 (path_in_vcs yrs). No invented copyright
attributions. Rust library HTML is rendered to plain text, retaining all text.

TandemLog carries an approved modification to yrs 0.28.0: Undo restoration
visits candidate items in immutable ID order. Original archive, source revision,
per-file hashes and patch identity are in vendor/yrs-provenance.json. The MIT
license below applies to the retained upstream source. No upstream authorship
or copyright notice has been replaced.
